subject: Energy
title: Why Energy Matters
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Why Energy Matters.

hook.text: Civilization runs on energy—every meal cooked, every mile driven, every message sent requires it.

buildup.text: The average American uses about 300 million joules per day—equivalent to running 80 marathons.

discovery.text: Most of that energy comes from fossil fuels—coal, oil, and gas still supply about 80% of global energy.

twist.text: Yet 750 million people worldwide lack reliable electricity—energy access shapes wealth, health, and opportunity.

climax.text: Understanding energy is understanding modern life—from climate change to geopolitics to your phone battery.

punchline.text: Control energy, and you shape civilization.

quiz.question: What percentage of global energy comes from fossil fuels?
